answer.reason: Zoar's story has two events of its own: it was spared at Lot's plea and Lot took refuge there, and its king fought in the vale of Siddim.

clauses.english: was spared from overthrow so that Lot could escape to it
clauses.quote: I will not overthrow this city, for the which thou hast spoken.

clauses.english: was where Lot fled as Sodom and Gomorrah were destroyed
clauses.quote: The sun was risen upon the earth when Lot entered into Zoar.

doubts: GEN 14:2 and 14:8 name its king (the king of Bela) in the battle of the vale of Siddim; left out as a minor detail.
ISA 15:5 and JER 48:34 mention Zoar in oracles about Moab, which is not an event of the place; DEU 34:3 only marks a boundary of the view.
